lines.text: RECEPTIONIST: You there!

I have to tell you that our office is a bit of
a disaster right now... A REAL disaster!\c
This is no place for kids—not when there are so
many dangerous people around!
BLUE: Aw, don’t be such a stick in the mud.\nYou won’t even let us have a little look around?
RECEPTIONIST: Oh!\nY...you’re Blue! THE Blue!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\nI’ve been looking for you!
What’re you doing in a place like this?
Well, Team Rocket...
I heard there was a take-over...
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: No surprise!\c\nThose Team Rocket goons are causing trouble\nall over the place!

BLUE: You and me are on the same wavelength,
[VAR TRNAME(0001)].\c
We can’t keep letting Team Rocket do whatever
they please!
That’s right!
What do we do?
BLUE: Come on!\nIt’s time we did a little strategy planning!
BLUE: We do whatever we can do!

BLUE: ...So in short, the plan is this:\c
[VAR TRNAME(0000)] is gonna drive Team Rocket
out of Silph Co., just like [VAR GENDBR(00FF,0100)]she planned.\c
But it’d be crazy to try something like that alone,
so [VAR TRNAME(0001)] is going with h[VAR GENDBR(00FF,0202)]imer.
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Right!

BLUE: While you pip-squeaks do that, I’m gonna
do a loop around all of Kanto, squashing out
Team Rocket wherever I find ’em!\c
One of us is sure to find out where
their boss is hiding.
And while I’m at it, I’ll swing by the Pokémon\nLeague to tell the bigwigs there what’s going on.
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Awesome!\nDo you think the Elite Four might come help us?!
BLUE: Maybe!\c\nSo that’s the battle plan, guy[VAR GENDBR(00FF,0801)]s and gal!\nTime to split up and put it into action!
...Heh. If only it were that simple.\c\nFact is, there’s one more thing we’ve gotta do\nhere first.
[VAR TRNAME(0000)]! [VAR TRNAME(0001)]!\nIf you want me to leave this place up to you two\r\nnewbies, then prove that you’re up to the task!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: What?!
BLUE: I don’t care who goes first, so show me\nwhat you’ve got!
BLUE: Hey now! You lost or something?\nI’m standing right here!

RECEPTIONIST: Have you come to save
Silph Co. from those criminals?\c
If you’re friends with a famous Trainer like Blue,
then I’m sure we can rely on you.

[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: If I can beat Blue, then I can
go get revenge for Marowak...
That’s right! I think maybe I can really do this!\c
[VAR TRNAME(0000)], you wanna go first?
